documents.title: Privacy policy
documents.summary: How Bounty for Android handles local records, sign-in, subscriptions, crash diagnostics and support requests.

sections.heading: Bounty and your choices
paragraphs: Bounty for Android is operated by Kunal Das personally and is listed under the developer name Kudos Labs. The app identifier is io.github.kunal26das.bounty. Contact kunal26das@gmail.com for privacy questions or account requests.

You can use Local and Demo workspaces without signing in. Google sign-in connects an account for subscription access; it does not automatically upload Local or Demo ledgers. Cloud sharing, invitations, remote receipt transfers and automatic cloud-account deletion are paused. Previously saved Cloud ledgers can be viewed and exported, and pending changes remain saved on the device.

sections.heading: Audience and availability
paragraphs: Bounty is a general-audience expense-recordkeeping app intended for availability in countries supported by Google Play. It is not designed or marketed specifically for children under 13. Store availability, provider services and applicable rights can differ by country.

Use sign-in and purchase features only when you meet the applicable provider's age and consent requirements. A parent or guardian should assist where the law or provider requires it. If you believe a child's information was provided without appropriate authorization, contact support with the minimum information needed to explain the concern. Do not send a child's private ledger, passwords or verification codes.

sections.heading: Ledger and receipt data on your device
paragraphs: The app stores the information you enter: your profile name, currency and spending targets; group and participant names or optional email addresses; expense amounts, dates, categories, payer contributions and shares; settlements, notes, comments, recurring rules, receipt itemization, exchange-rate records and activity history. Private loan records can include loan and counterparty names, borrowed or lent direction, opening principal and date, supplied dues, repayment amounts and dates, principal/interest/fee classifications, applications to dues, reversals and notes. Selected receipt images or PDFs are stored as attachments in the workspace.

Bounty does not automatically sync Local or Demo ledgers. Exports and incidental crash-diagnostic data are described below. Private loans are device records in Local or Demo; they do not change group balances or sync to Cloud. A ledger backup contains receipt references, not the attached image or PDF bytes. Keep separate copies of receipt files you need. Bounty does not read your address book or automatically import your other files.
Receipt text scanning runs when you request it. Android uses on-device ML Kit text recognition; review recognized text before saving. This path does not send receipt images to a Bounty OCR server.

Google's bundled ML Kit SDK processes installation identifiers, device and app information, and feature configuration, performance, usage and error information for diagnostics and usage analytics. On-device receipt recognition does not mean that the SDK sends no technical data.

sections.heading: Google sign-in and account information
paragraphs: When you choose Google sign-in, Google and Firebase Authentication process the request. Bounty receives an account identifier, provider identity and available name, email and profile-image URL. Bounty uses the Firebase user identifier to associate account access and subscription status. When displaying an available profile image, the app requests it from its HTTPS image host; that host receives ordinary network request information. Initials are shown when no image is available or it cannot load. Profile images are not saved to a persistent image disk cache.

Firebase Authentication processes technical information such as IP addresses and user-agent information for authentication and abuse prevention. Bounty can remember up to ten accounts on the device so you can switch without repeatedly opening the provider chooser while a saved sign-in remains valid. Android session secrets use Keystore-backed encryption. Signing out removes only the selected account’s saved sign-in and does not automatically select another remembered account. You can remove other saved sign-ins through the account menu. Removing a saved sign-in does not delete that account’s retained Cloud ledger or pending edits; those stay separately scoped on the device.
Accounts are not automatically joined by matching email addresses. Self-service account linking is unavailable; do not assume that signing in to another account transfers records or joins identities.

sections.heading: Subscriptions and service providers
paragraphs: Bounty uses RevenueCat and Google Play to obtain subscription options, validate purchases, restore access and check Pro status. RevenueCat receives the Firebase user identifier and purchase or subscription information, including product, transaction and entitlement status, along with SDK and platform information needed to provide its service. RevenueCat also provides purchase analytics. Bounty's billing adapter does not send ledger notes, expense amounts or receipt attachments to RevenueCat. RevenueCat can determine a country from a transaction or, when unavailable, the last-seen network IP address. Its documentation states that it drops the IP address after determining the country.

Google Play handles payment details for Android purchases. Bounty's billing adapter does not receive full payment-card details. Google, Firebase and RevenueCat have their own data-processing practices. Paid Apple and web offerings are unavailable; this Android policy does not promise cross-platform purchase continuity.

The Android app has no advertising SDK, advertising-identifier collection, cross-app advertising tracking integration or data-sale feature. It does not integrate a separate general-purpose analytics SDK. Crash reporting is described below; account, purchase, support and other technical processing still apply.

sections.heading: Crash reporting on Android
paragraphs: Android releases use Firebase Crashlytics to diagnose crashes and app-not-responding problems. Google receives crash traces, exception details, relevant app state, app and device information, and installation and session identifiers and timing for stability metrics. Native crashes can also include crash-memory dumps.

Bounty does not attach account IDs, email addresses, ledger records, receipt files, chat prompts or authentication secrets as custom Crashlytics data, and does not add Google Analytics or user-action breadcrumbs for this integration. Automatic reports may still contain data present in exception messages or captured native memory; they are not guaranteed anonymous.

Google states that Crashlytics keeps crash traces, extracted native-crash data and associated identifiers for 90 days before beginning removal from live and backup systems. Raw native minidumps are held temporarily for processing and then discarded. This provider process is separate from the support-record retention periods below. The current Firebase privacy information is available at https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy.

sections.heading: Exports, sharing, support and security
paragraphs: You control when Bounty opens a file picker, exports records, copies text or invokes the system share sheet. Files or messages you send are handled by the destination you select. An export may include other participants' details, notes and financial records; review it before sharing.

If you export recorded loan due dates, Bounty creates a calendar file for unpaid dates on active loans in the next 12 months, up to 600 events. The file uses a generic recorded-loan-due label and excludes lender names, amounts and alarms. The file does not update after payments or schedule changes. Opening or importing it in another app is your choice; review old calendar entries yourself. Bounty does not schedule automatic loan notifications.

If you contact support by email, your address, message and attachments are processed to respond to your request. Send only the minimum information needed; do not send passwords, sign-in codes, authentication tokens, full payment-card details or unredacted private ledgers. Support records are restricted to the operator.

Bounty uses encrypted HTTPS connections for its authentication and subscription services. Device and account security also depend on protecting your device and Google account. The public information pages receive ordinary hosting requests, including network information; they have no analytics scripts, external fonts, embedded trackers or submission form.

sections.heading: Storage, retention and deletion
paragraphs: Local ledgers and attachments remain on your device until you remove or replace them. Signing out does not erase saved ledgers or pending Cloud changes. Device app-data removal can remove local records. Exported files and copies you send elsewhere remain outside Bounty's control.

We retain sign-in and subscription account records while your Bounty account exists. When a verified deletion request is fulfilled, we remove the account-associated records we control, except specific records retained for a legitimate reason as explained below. Support checks Firebase Authentication, RevenueCat customer identifiers and aliases, any configured downstream integrations and any pre-existing hosted Bounty data. Temporarily disabling an account is not completed deletion.

We delete raw diagnostic support attachments 30 days after a request is closed and retain a minimal ordinary-support summary for 12 months after closure to follow up recurring issues and document the response. An account-deletion request also covers those account-associated support records unless a specific legitimate retention need applies. For verification or deletion handling, we keep a separate minimal record for 90 days after completion to help protect against unauthorized account changes and resolve questions about the handling. A deletion request does not also receive a duplicate 12-month support record. These records contain only the necessary reference, relevant dates, actions and retention reasons, rather than reusable credentials or full private ledgers.

Where an active dispute, security or fraud-prevention need, or a legal obligation requires longer retention, we keep only the necessary records, document the specific reason and review when that need ends. We explain the affected records and applicable retention criteria in the request result. These exceptions do not permit indefinite retention of unrelated personal information.

Google Play may retain transaction records under its own obligations. Firebase, RevenueCat and other service providers have their own security, transaction and backup retention practices. Removing a Bounty account does not delete your Google account or erase independent provider records. We distinguish provider-controlled records from records Bounty can remove and explain any request that remains unfinished.

You can request account or associated-data deletion from Your corner → Request account deletion, through the Account and data deletion page, or by emailing support. Support independently verifies ownership and confirms the completed and retained data separately. We aim to acknowledge requests within 7 calendar days and handle them within 30 days; we explain additional verification, outstanding steps or delays. These aims do not limit applicable rights or guarantee that every provider finishes deletion within that period. An email composer or submitted request is not itself proof of deletion, and account deletion does not cancel a subscription.

Bounty does not add your account identity to Crashlytics reports. Removing a Bounty account does not by itself identify or immediately erase installation-based crash diagnostics held by Google. Support explains any provider-controlled retention or deletion limitation when handling a request.

documents.title: Terms of use
documents.summary: Using Bounty for Android expense and private loan records and optional Pro features.

sections.heading: Purpose and availability
paragraphs: Bounty for Android is operated by Kunal Das personally. It helps you keep shared-expense records, calculate allocations, record settlements and track private borrowed or lent loans with supplied dues and actual repayments. Recording a settlement or repayment does not transfer money or verify that a bank payment occurred. Supplied EMI schedules are records you enter, not a calculated interest split or a lender-confirmed balance. Unknown principal or payment components remain unknown. Bounty does not connect a bank account or provide a bank, wallet, lending or money-transfer service.

Local and Demo remain separate; signing in does not automatically upload either workspace. Cloud sharing, invitations and remote receipts are paused. Features depend on supported devices, provider availability and subscription status. Bounty is intended as a general-audience app in Google Play-supported countries.

sections.heading: Your records and account
paragraphs: Review amounts, participants, currencies, shares, receipt text and imported data before relying on them. Review loan opening balances, schedule coverage, payment classifications and due applications against your own records. An incomplete supplied schedule does not mean nothing else is owed. Calendar exports are snapshots that do not update after payments or schedule changes. Keep your own records for payments, taxes or agreements with others. A balance records what users entered; it does not establish that a payment occurred or resolve a dispute between participants.

Only use or share information you have permission to use. Avoid unnecessary sensitive information about yourself or other people. Protect your device and Google account, and contact support if you believe your Bounty account is being used without authorization.

Keep exports and original receipt files where you can recover them. A ledger backup includes attachment references, not attachment bytes. Device loss, cleared app storage or unsupported storage can affect access to local records.

sections.heading: Pro subscriptions
paragraphs: Bounty Pro offers optional advanced insights, creation or changes to recurring expense rules, and supported receipt text scanning. Core splitting, recorded settlements, manual private loan and repayment tracking, supplied loan schedules, calendar exports, manual itemization and ledger exports do not require Pro. Existing ledger records and recurring rules remain accessible when Pro ends.

Where Google Play offers a plan, the app displays its localized price and billing period before purchase. Monthly and yearly are alternative auto-renewing plans. Manage renewal with Google Play; uninstalling Bounty, signing out or deleting an account does not cancel a subscription.

Read Subscription information for restore, availability and account-identity limits. No free trial, lifetime plan or unavailable Cloud benefit is advertised. Refund and cancellation rights follow the purchase provider and applicable requirements.

sections.heading: Questions and account requests
paragraphs: Contact kunal26das@gmail.com for support, privacy questions or account requests. Do not send passwords, sign-in codes, tokens or full payment-card details. A support request does not itself cancel a purchase or confirm account deletion.

Privacy policy and Account and data deletion explain data handling, retention and verified requests. We aim to acknowledge requests within 7 calendar days and handle them within 30 days, with an explanation of additional verification or delays. These operating aims do not limit applicable consumer or privacy rights.

documents.title: Subscription information
documents.summary: Bounty Pro benefits, Google Play renewal, restore and cancellation.

sections.heading: What Bounty Pro includes
paragraphs: Pro provides advanced insights, creation or changes to recurring expense rules, and optional receipt text scanning on supported Android devices. Cloud sharing is paused and is not a paid benefit.

Groups, exact and unequal splits, currency-separated ledgers, recorded settlements, manual private loan and repayment tracking, supplied loan schedules, calendar exports, manual receipt itemization, attachments and ledger exports remain free. Existing records and recurring rules remain accessible after Pro ends. Demo previews do not create a subscription or grant Pro in another workspace.

sections.heading: Price, billing period and renewal
paragraphs: Choose an available monthly or yearly Google Play plan. Bounty displays the actual localized price and period returned by the store. Checkout is authoritative for the amount, currency, taxes and any offer. The yearly price is charged for the full year, not in monthly instalments. No free trial is advertised.
Google Play charges payment when you confirm the purchase. A plan automatically renews for its displayed period unless renewal is cancelled through Google Play before the applicable deadline.

Use Manage subscriptions in Bounty or Google Play subscription settings to view renewal details and cancel. Cancellation ordinarily stops a future renewal; access and refunds follow Google Play and applicable rights. For a monthly/yearly change, use the available plan-change control and review the replacement amount and renewal date in checkout rather than buying a second subscription.

sections.heading: Sign-in, restore and changing devices
paragraphs: Sign in to the Bounty account that should hold Pro before a purchase or restore. Bounty associates subscription status with the Firebase user identifier. The current RevenueCat transfer setting means restoring or purchasing with the same Google Play account can move Pro from another Bounty account to the account being used. RevenueCat updates access for the previous account; expense records remain separate and are not merged.

On another Android device, use the same intended Bounty identity and the Google Play account used for the purchase, then choose Restore purchases. Account linking and cross-platform purchase continuity are not offered. Paid Apple and web products are unavailable.

A cancelled checkout grants no new access. If the provider reports a pending payment, Bounty waits for confirmation. If plans are unavailable, retry later or contact support. Bounty does not invent a price or active subscription. Subscription commands require a current sign-in check; when that check cannot reach the service, saved Local records remain available and subscription access may need a retry.

sections.heading: Deletion and billing help
paragraphs: Deleting app data, deleting a Bounty account, signing out or uninstalling does not cancel a Google Play subscription. Manage renewal separately with Google Play. You may keep a purchase reference for support; never send full card details or a store password.

Use Google Play for its cancellation and refund controls, and contact kunal26das@gmail.com if Bounty access is incorrect. A support email does not itself change billing. Account and data deletion explains how verified account requests are handled.

documents.title: Support
documents.summary: Contact support, protect local records and request account help.

sections.heading: Contact Bounty
paragraphs: Contact the monitored Bounty inbox at kunal26das@gmail.com. Include the version in Your corner, Android version, what you expected, what happened and the steps to reproduce the problem. Include only the minimum information needed. Screenshots are optional; remove other people's names, expense details and private information.
Never send passwords, sign-in codes, session tokens, private keys, full card details or an unredacted ledger. The support action opens your email app; it does not send automatically.

We aim to acknowledge requests within 7 calendar days and handle them within 30 days. We explain extra verification, outstanding provider steps or delays. These aims are not guaranteed completion deadlines and do not limit applicable rights. Privacy policy explains support-record retention.

sections.heading: Protect a saved ledger
paragraphs: Before reinstalling, clearing app data, importing a replacement backup or changing accounts, use Your corner → Your data → Ledger backup. It includes the current workspace’s expense and private loan records. Keep original receipt files separately: backups contain receipt references, not attachment bytes. Exports may contain other people’s data; store them privately. Keep lender statements or payment evidence independently. Exported calendar entries do not update automatically after repayments or corrections.

Cloud sharing is paused. Local and Demo remain usable; previously saved Cloud records are read-only and exportable, with pending changes preserved on the device. Signing out does not erase these records or transfer them to another account.

If a saved session used retired email/password sign-in, preserve it and export before signing out. A supported provider must already identify the same account to recover access. Matching email text does not prove account ownership; no automatic account merge is available.

sections.heading: Subscriptions and account deletion
paragraphs: Use Restore purchases while signed in to the intended Bounty identity, or Manage subscriptions for Google Play renewal controls. A purchase reference can help investigate access, but never send card details or a store password.

For account or associated-data removal, choose Request account deletion in Your corner or use Account and data deletion. Support accepts manual requests and independently verifies ownership before changes. Automatic Cloud cleanup is unavailable; actual results and retained data are confirmed separately. Cancelling a subscription and deleting an account are separate actions.

documents.title: Account and data deletion
documents.summary: Request Bounty account or associated-data deletion without reinstalling the app.

sections.heading: Account deletion requests
paragraphs: Bounty accepts account and associated-data deletion requests at kunal26das@gmail.com. In Android, open Your corner → Request account deletion to read these instructions and compose an email. You can also request directly without reinstalling Bounty or creating another account.

Support handles requests manually and independently verifies ownership before changes. Opening the email composer does not send automatically. A drafted or sent request, signing out, uninstalling or removing local files does not confirm account deletion. You receive the actual result and any retained-data explanation separately.

Automatic Cloud cleanup is unavailable. Support checks for any existing hosted data associated with the account as part of manual handling. If a system or record cannot yet be inspected or removed, we explain the unfinished work and do not report the request complete.

sections.heading: How to request account or data deletion
paragraphs: Email kunal26das@gmail.com with the subject Bounty account deletion or Bounty data request. State whether you want the account and associated data removed, a copy of data or help removing particular data. Include the sign-in provider, platform and account email shown in Bounty if available. The Support ID can help locate the account but is not proof of ownership.

Do not send a Google password, sign-in code, ID/access/refresh token, full card details or private ledger. Support confirms ownership using contact details independently checked against the account or another appropriate verification method. An incoming address, display name, screenshot or purchase reference alone does not authorize deletion.

We aim to acknowledge within 7 calendar days and handle the request within 30 days. We explain additional verification, provider steps, legitimate retention or delays. These aims do not guarantee that every provider completes erasure within that period and do not limit applicable rights.

You may export records and keep original receipts before removal; this is optional and not a condition for requesting deletion. Deleting the Bounty account can end access to its identity and Pro. It does not cancel a Google Play subscription; manage renewal separately with Google Play.

sections.heading: What account handling covers
paragraphs: After verification, support checks the exact Firebase account, RevenueCat customer identifiers and aliases, configured downstream integrations and any pre-existing hosted Bounty account data. We remove records under our control that are associated with the account, subject to specific legitimate retention explained in the result. Firebase account deletion does not delete your Google account.

Deleting a RevenueCat customer does not cancel the Google Play subscription or erase Google Play order records. Provider security, transaction and backup retention is handled separately. We distinguish an accepted removal operation from confirmed completion and do not use temporary account disablement as a substitute for deletion.

We do not assume that all RevenueCat aliases belong to one person, or that relabelling a participant removes personal information. If historical shared records contain personal text or identifiers, support reviews that data and any specific necessary retention. Unrelated personal information is not retained indefinitely merely to preserve a display name or financial total. The actual scope, reason and duration or retention criteria are explained to the requester.

Crashlytics diagnostics use installation and session identifiers; Bounty does not attach your account identity. Account deletion does not by itself identify or immediately erase those reports held by Google. See the privacy policy for Google’s crash-data retention process, and contact support about an applicable data request.

sections.heading: Retention of request records
paragraphs: Raw diagnostic attachments are deleted 30 days after request closure. A minimal ordinary-support summary is retained for 12 months after closure to follow up recurring issues and document the response. Account-deletion requests also cover those account-associated support records unless a specific legitimate retention need applies. A separate minimal verification or deletion record is kept for 90 days after completion to protect against unauthorized account changes and resolve questions about the handling; the same deletion request does not receive a duplicate 12-month support record. Reusable passwords or tokens are not requested or retained as proof.

Only necessary records are retained longer for an active dispute, a security or fraud-prevention need, or a legal obligation. We document the specific reason and review when it ends. Privacy policy describes the remaining account, provider and device-data limits.

sections.heading: Local records and exported copies
paragraphs: Local and Demo workspaces are separate from the signed-in account. Removing that account does not remotely erase them. To remove local Android records, use app-data controls after saving anything you need; sign out first when possible.

Exports, original receipt files and copies held by other people are independent copies. Remove them from their saved locations or ask recipients where appropriate. Account deletion cannot remotely erase an exported copy on another device.
